messages.thinking:
**Comprehensive Storage Optimization and Concurrency Strategy**

Okay, here's the game plan for efficiently managing and tracking storage usage, especially in Rails 8. We're leveraging `insert_all!` and UUIDv7 generation for database interactions. The core of this system revolves around `Storage::Entry` and a robust consolidation strategy for large numbers of records. 

When a large number of entries are created for an owner, such as an account or a board, we want to consolidate them to reduce database load. If inserts happen within background jobs, we want to *enqueue* the consolidation job rather than running it inline to avoid contention. This also means we want a background job to run, even if the count is currently close to the threshold. If there's a race with multiple consolidation jobs enqueued, we can have jobs that run very fast, or exit early. We're using a configurable `CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD`, and we'll be able to manually trigger consolidation as needed, which gives the flexibility we need.

We're carefully tracing the logic for recording storage deltas during operations like card moves (which should only track bytes *moved* between boards, and only if the `from_board` exists), and for cleaning up storage when boards or other objects are destroyed. The cleanup process for Boards will be optimized to handle large numbers of tracked records with a batching strategy. We'll use batched processing (e.g., `find_in_batches`) to avoid memory issues when dealing with a massive number of tracked items, especially in the `CleanupJob` operations for `Board`, `Card`, and `Comment`. These batch operations are important, especially when a card is destroyed, to make sure memory usage is bounded. The `CleanupJob` operations will handle potential race conditions during board/card/comment destruction, such as when a card is moved to a new board right before cleanup.

Concurrency is a major focus. We're carefully considering the potential race condition where multiple sync jobs try to create a `Storage::TrackedRecord` simultaneously. The transaction-based locking strategy ensures data integrity, even in the face of concurrent operations in SQLite and other DBs. We want to be certain that the code is bulletproof and avoids deadlocks. We'll also check SQLite concurrency in tests and production to ensure our application behaves predictably.

Triggers are super important. We're meticulously listing and reviewing every trigger that may cause a `Storage::SyncJob` or `Storage::CleanupJob` to be enqueued. `ActiveStorage::Attachment` events (create, destroy, purge) are essential. `Board`, `Card`, and `Comment` models are tracked with `Storage::Trackable`. `Card` changes, particularly `board_id` updates via `card.move_to(new_board)`, trigger sync jobs. `Board` and `Comment` destruction uses cleanup jobs. `Account` destroy operations will suppress child storage events. The code must handle the critical scenario of an existing image being replaced or purged on a `Card`. This includes the correct sequencing of ActiveStorage callbacks (create, destroy, etc.) to ensure accurate storage tracking. Enqueueing jobs after transaction commits (using `enqueue_after_transaction_commit`) is critical to ensure we don't enqueue work that should be discarded with a rollback.

Finally, we're double-checking the code to ensure we never have code that relies on `Current.account`, by using the actual model attributes (`account_id`, `board_id`, etc.) wherever possible. We are particularly concerned about ensuring that the tests work correctly and that no code implicitly depends on an active `Current.account`. We want our jobs to be reliable regardless of the `Current.account` set in any code. We will also examine how `ActionText::RichText` interactions affect storage, particularly when existing blobs are reused, or when a blob is modified. We will look at testing the interaction of `Account` incineration with our Storage code to ensure the entire system is robust and that no existing tests or saas/ tests fail because of our changes.

class Account::IncineratableTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @account = accounts(:"37s")
    @user = users(:david)
  end

  test "incinerate destroys account" do
    assert_difference -> { Account.count }, -1 do
      @account.incinerate
    end

    assert_not Account.exists?(@account.id)
  end

  test "due_for_incineration finds old cancellations" do
    @account.cancel(initiated_by: @user)

    @account.cancellation.update!(created_at: 31.days.ago)
    assert_equal [ @account ], Account.due_for_incineration

    @account.cancellation.update!(created_at: 29.days.ago)
    assert Account.due_for_incineration.empty?
  end

  test "incinerate destroys all associated records" do
    account = accounts(:initech)
    board = boards(:miltons_wish_list)
    card = cards(:radio)

    Current.account = account
    Current.session = Session.new(identity: identities(:mike))

    user = users(:mike)
    user.create_settings!(bundle_email_frequency: :never)

    # Direct on Account
    tag = Tag.create!(title: "urgent")

    # Via Webhook
    delivery = Webhook::Delivery.create!(webhook: webhook, event: event)

    goldness = Card::Goldness.create!(card: card)
    not_now = Card::NotNow.create!(card: cards(:unfinished_thoughts), user: user)
    activity_spike = Card::ActivitySpike.create!(card: card)

module Storage
  def self.table_name_prefix
    "storage_"
  end

  class << self
    def sync_later(record)
      return unless record&.persisted?
      return if suppressed_for?(record)

      Storage::SyncJob.perform_later(record)
    end

    def suppressing_destroy(record)
      key = suppression_key_for(record)
      stack = suppressed_keys
      added = key && !stack.include?(key)
      stack.add(key) if added
      yield
    ensure
      stack.delete(key) if added
    end

    def suppressed_by_parent?(record)
      case record
      when Board
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ])
      when Card
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :board, record.board_id ])
      when Comment
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :card, record.card_id ]) ||
          (record.association(:card).loaded? && suppressed_keys.include?([ :board, record.card&.board_id ]))
      else
        false
      end
    end

    def suppressed_for?(record)
      case record
      when Board
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :board, record.id ])
      when Card
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :board, record.board_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :card, record.id ])
      when Comment
        suppressed_keys.include?([ :account, record.account_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :card, record.card_id ]) ||
          suppressed_keys.include?([ :comment, record.id ]) ||
          (record.association(:card).loaded? && suppressed_keys.include?([ :board, record.card&.board_id ]))
      else
        false
      end
    end

    private
      def suppression_key_for(record)
        case record
        when Account then [ :account, record.id ]
        when Board   then [ :board, record.id ]
        when Card    then [ :card, record.id ]
        when Comment then [ :comment, record.id ]
        end
      end

      def suppressed_keys
        Thread.current[:storage_suppressed_keys] ||= Set.new
      end
  end
end

class Storage::Entry < ApplicationRecord
  CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD = 10

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :owner, polymorphic: true

  class << self
    def record(account_id:, board_id:, delta:)
      return if delta.zero?

      entries = [
        { id: ActiveRecord::Type::Uuid.generate, account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id, delta: delta }
      ]

      if board_id
        entries << { id: ActiveRecord::Type::Uuid.generate, account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id, delta: delta }
      end

      insert_all!(entries)
    end

    def record_board(account_id:, board_id:, delta:)
      return if delta.zero? || board_id.nil?

      insert_all!([
        { id: ActiveRecord::Type::Uuid.generate, account_id: account_id, owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id, delta: delta }
      ])
    end

    def consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id:, board_id:)
      if account_id && where(owner_type: "Account", owner_id: account_id).count >= CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD
        if account = Account.find_by(id: account_id)
          Storage::ConsolidateJob.perform_later(account)
        end
      end

      if board_id && where(owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id).count >= CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD
        if board = Board.find_by(id: board_id)
          Storage::ConsolidateJob.perform_later(board)
        end
      end
    end

    def consolidate_now(owner)
      loop do
        ids = where(owner: owner).order(:id).limit(1000).pluck(:id)
        break if ids.size <= 1

        consolidated = transaction do
          if owner.class.lock.find_by(id: owner.id)
            rows = where(id: ids).lock.pluck(:id, :delta)
            if rows.size > 1
              deleted = where(id: rows.map(&:first)).delete_all
              if deleted == rows.size
                total = rows.sum(&:last)
                create!(account_id: owner.account.id, owner: owner, delta: total) unless total.zero?
                true
              else
                raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
              end
            else
              false
            end
          else
            false
          end
        end

        break unless consolidated
        break if ids.size < 1000
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

class Storage::TrackedRecord < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :board
  belongs_to :card, optional: true
  belongs_to :record, polymorphic: true

  class << self
    def sync_board_now(board_id)
      transaction do
        if board = Board.lock.find_by(id: board_id)
          current_bytes = board.storage_bytes_used
          tracked = lock.find_by(record_type: "Board", record_id: board.id)
          delta = current_bytes - (tracked&.bytes_used || 0)

          persist_tracked_record(
            tracked: tracked,
            account_id: board.account_id,
            board_id: board.id,
            card_id: nil,
            record_type: "Board",
            record_id: board.id,
            bytes_used: current_bytes
          )

          if delta != 0
            Storage::Entry.record(account_id: board.account_id, board_id: board.id, delta: delta)
            Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: board.account_id, board_id: board.id)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def sync_card_now(card_id)
      transaction do
        if card = Card.lock.find_by(id: card_id)
          current_bytes = card.storage_bytes_used
          tracked = lock.find_by(record_type: "Card", record_id: card.id)

          boards_to_consolidate = Set.new
          account_delta = 0

          if tracked && tracked.board_id != card.board_id
            old_board_id = tracked.board_id
            old_bytes = tracked.bytes_used

            if old_bytes != 0 && Board.exists?(id: old_board_id)
              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: old_board_id, delta: -old_bytes)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(old_board_id)
            end

            if current_bytes != 0
              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: card.board_id, delta: current_bytes)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(card.board_id)
            end

            account_delta = current_bytes - old_bytes
          else
            delta = current_bytes - (tracked&.bytes_used || 0)
            if delta != 0
              Storage::Entry.record(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: card.board_id, delta: delta)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(card.board_id)
            end
          end

          persist_tracked_record(
            tracked: tracked,
            account_id: card.account_id,
            board_id: card.board_id,
            card_id: card.id,
            record_type: "Card",
            record_id: card.id,
            bytes_used: current_bytes
          )

          moved_comments_delta = sync_moved_comments_for(card)
          boards_to_consolidate.merge(moved_comments_delta)

          if account_delta != 0
            Storage::Entry.record(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: nil, delta: account_delta)
          end

          if account_delta != 0 || boards_to_consolidate.any?
            Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: nil)
            boards_to_consolidate.each do |b_id|
              Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: nil, board_id: b_id)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def sync_comment_now(comment_id)
      comment_card_id = Comment.where(id: comment_id).pick(:card_id)
      return unless comment_card_id

      transaction do
        card = Card.lock.find_by(id: comment_card_id)
        comment = Comment.lock.find_by(id: comment_id)
        if card && comment
          current_bytes = comment.storage_bytes_used
          tracked = lock.find_by(record_type: "Comment", record_id: comment.id)
          boards_to_consolidate = Set.new
          recorded_account_delta = false

          if tracked && tracked.board_id != card.board_id
            old_board_id = tracked.board_id
            old_bytes = tracked.bytes_used

            if old_bytes != 0 && Board.exists?(id: old_board_id)
              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: old_board_id, delta: -old_bytes)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(old_board_id)
            end

            if current_bytes != 0
              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: card.board_id, delta: current_bytes)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(card.board_id)
            end

            account_delta = current_bytes - old_bytes
            if account_delta != 0
              Storage::Entry.record(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: nil, delta: account_delta)
              recorded_account_delta = true
            end
          else
            delta = current_bytes - (tracked&.bytes_used || 0)
            if delta != 0
              Storage::Entry.record(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: card.board_id, delta: delta)
              boards_to_consolidate.add(card.board_id)
              recorded_account_delta = true
            end
          end

          persist_tracked_record(
            tracked: tracked,
            account_id: card.account_id,
            board_id: card.board_id,
            card_id: card.id,
            record_type: "Comment",
            record_id: comment.id,
            bytes_used: current_bytes
          )

          if recorded_account_delta
            Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: nil)
          end
          boards_to_consolidate.each do |b_id|
            Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: nil, board_id: b_id)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def cleanup_now(record_type:, record_id:, account_id:)
      return unless Account.exists?(id: account_id)

      case record_type
      when "Board"
        cleanup_board_now(board_id: record_id, account_id: account_id)
      when "Card"
        cleanup_card_now(card_id: record_id, account_id: account_id)
      when "Comment"
        cleanup_comment_now(comment_id: record_id, account_id: account_id)
      end
    end

    private
      def persist_tracked_record(tracked:, account_id:, board_id:, card_id:, record_type:, record_id:, bytes_used:)
        if bytes_used.zero?
          tracked&.destroy!
        elsif tracked
          tracked.update!(board_id: board_id, bytes_used: bytes_used)
        else
          create!(
            account_id: account_id,
            board_id: board_id,
            card_id: card_id,
            record_type: record_type,
            record_id: record_id,
            bytes_used: bytes_used
          )
        end
      end

      def sync_moved_comments_for(card)
        moved_by_board = Hash.new(0)

        where(card_id: card.id, record_type: "Comment").where.not(board_id: card.board_id).find_in_batches(batch_size: 1000) do |batch|
          rows = where(id: batch.map(&:id)).lock.pluck(:id, :board_id, :bytes_used)
          next if rows.empty?

          rows.each { |_id, old_board_id, bytes| moved_by_board[old_board_id] += bytes }
          where(id: rows.map(&:first)).update_all(board_id: card.board_id)
        end

        touched_boards = Set.new
        if moved_by_board.any?
          existing_board_ids = Board.where(id: moved_by_board.keys).pluck(:id).to_set
          total_moved = 0

          moved_by_board.each do |old_board_id, bytes|
            next if bytes.zero?

            total_moved += bytes
            if existing_board_ids.include?(old_board_id)
              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: old_board_id, delta: -bytes)
              touched_boards.add(old_board_id)
            end
          end

          if total_moved != 0
            Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: card.account_id, board_id: card.board_id, delta: total_moved)
            touched_boards.add(card.board_id)
          end
        end

        touched_boards
      end

      def cleanup_board_now(board_id:, account_id:)
        return if Board.exists?(id: board_id)

        Storage::Entry.where(owner_type: "Board", owner_id: board_id).delete_all

        total_destroyed_bytes = 0

        where(board_id: board_id).find_in_batches(batch_size: 1000) do |batch|
          transaction do
            rows = where(id: batch.map(&:id)).lock.pluck(:id, :card_id, :bytes_used)
            next if rows.empty?

            card_ids = rows.filter_map { |_id, card_id, _bytes| card_id }.uniq
            surviving_card_ids = card_ids.any? ? Card.where(id: card_ids).pluck(:id).to_set : Set.new

            destroyed_ids = []
            rows.each do |id, card_id, bytes|
              next if card_id && surviving_card_ids.include?(card_id)

              destroyed_ids << id
              total_destroyed_bytes += bytes
            end

            where(id: destroyed_ids).delete_all if destroyed_ids.any?
          end
        end

        if total_destroyed_bytes != 0
          Storage::Entry.record(account_id: account_id, board_id: nil, delta: -total_destroyed_bytes)
          Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: account_id, board_id: nil)
        end
      end

      def cleanup_card_now(card_id:, account_id:)
        return if Card.exists?(id: card_id)

        total_bytes = 0
        by_board = Hash.new(0)

        transaction do
          where(card_id: card_id).find_in_batches(batch_size: 1000) do |batch|
            rows = where(id: batch.map(&:id)).lock.pluck(:id, :board_id, :bytes_used)
            next if rows.empty?

            rows.each do |_id, board_id, bytes|
              by_board[board_id] += bytes
              total_bytes += bytes
            end

            where(id: rows.map(&:first)).delete_all
          end

          if total_bytes != 0
            Storage::Entry.record(account_id: account_id, board_id: nil, delta: -total_bytes)

            existing_board_ids = Board.where(id: by_board.keys).pluck(:id).to_set
            by_board.each do |board_id, bytes|
              next if bytes.zero? || !existing_board_ids.include?(board_id)

              Storage::Entry.record_board(account_id: account_id, board_id: board_id, delta: -bytes)
              Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: nil, board_id: board_id)
            end

            Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: account_id, board_id: nil)
          end
        end
      end

      def cleanup_comment_now(comment_id:, account_id:)
        return if Comment.exists?(id: comment_id)

        transaction do
          if tracked = lock.find_by(record_type: "Comment", record_id: comment_id)
            bytes = tracked.bytes_used
            board_id = tracked.board_id
            tracked.destroy!

            if bytes != 0
              existing_board_id = Board.exists?(id: board_id) ? board_id : nil
              Storage::Entry.record(account_id: account_id, board_id: existing_board_id, delta: -bytes)
              Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: account_id, board_id: existing_board_id)
            end
          end
        end
      end
  end
end
EOF

Let me dive into the `Account::Storage` concern. It'll include relationships for `storage_entries` and `storage_tracked_records`, with appropriate dependent destruction. The `bytes_used` method will sum the deltas from related entries. Crucially, I'm defining `reconcile_storage_later` to enqueue a job and `reconcile_storage_now` to handle the immediate reconciliation. Inside `reconcile_storage_now`, I'm carefully querying for boards, cards, and comments with linked embeds and images, and then calling `sync_storage_now` on them. I also call `reconcile_stale_tracked_records` which will loop through and reconcile stale tracked records. I'm also using the  `suppress_storage_tracking` method that calls an overarching `::Storage.suppressing_destroy` method. 

I'm paying close attention to avoiding constant resolution ambiguity. When inside a module like `Account::Storage`, referencing `Storage` directly could lead to the wrong constant being resolved. So, I use `::Storage` to be explicit.

Now, let's look at `Board::Storage`. This concern has similar logic: relationships with `storage_entries` and a `bytes_used` method. I'm adding `sync_storage_later`, `sync_storage_now`, and `storage_bytes_used` methods. Inside `storage_bytes_used` I'm doing a sum for active storage blobs. I've also implemented methods to suppress storage tracking with a shared method on `::Storage`, mark storage cleanup on destroy, and enqueue a cleanup job for later. There's also some interesting conditional logic to avoid enqueuing unnecessary jobs. module Account::Storage
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    has_many :storage_entries, class_name: "Storage::Entry", dependent: :delete_all
    has_many :storage_tracked_records, class_name: "Storage::TrackedRecord", dependent: :delete_all

    around_destroy :suppress_storage_tracking
  end

  def bytes_used
    ::Storage::Entry.where(owner: self).sum(:delta)
  end

  def reconcile_storage_later
    ::Storage::ReconcileJob.perform_later(self)
  end

  def reconcile_storage_now
    boards_with_embeds = ActionText::RichText
      .where(account_id: id, record_type: "Board", name: "public_description")
      .joins(:embeds_attachments)
      .select(:record_id)
    boards.where(id: boards_with_embeds).find_each(&:sync_storage_now)

    cards_with_images = ActiveStorage::Attachment
      .where(account_id: id, record_type: "Card", name: "image")
      .select(:record_id)
    cards_with_embeds = ActionText::RichText
      .where(account_id: id, record_type: "Card", name: "description")
      .joins(:embeds_attachments)
      .select(:record_id)
    cards.where(id: cards_with_images).or(cards.where(id: cards_with_embeds)).find_each(&:sync_storage_now)

    comments_with_embeds = ActionText::RichText
      .where(account_id: id, record_type: "Comment", name: "body")
      .joins(:embeds_attachments)
      .select(:record_id)
    Comment.where(account_id: id, id: comments_with_embeds).find_each(&:sync_storage_now)

    reconcile_stale_tracked_records
  end

  private
    def suppress_storage_tracking(&block)
      ::Storage.suppressing_destroy(self, &block)
    end

    def reconcile_stale_tracked_records
      storage_tracked_records.find_each do |tracked|
        case tracked.record_type
        when "Board"
          if board = boards.find_by(id: tracked.record_id)
            board.sync_storage_now if board.storage_bytes_used != tracked.bytes_used
          else
            ::Storage::TrackedRecord.cleanup_now(record_type: "Board", record_id: tracked.record_id, account_id: id)
          end
        when "Card"
          if card = cards.find_by(id: tracked.record_id)
            card.sync_storage_now if card.board_id != tracked.board_id || card.storage_bytes_used != tracked.bytes_used
          else
            ::Storage::TrackedRecord.cleanup_now(record_type: "Card", record_id: tracked.record_id, account_id: id)
          end
        when "Comment"
          if comment = Comment.find_by(account_id: id, id: tracked.record_id)
            comment.sync_storage_now if comment.card.board_id != tracked.board_id || comment.storage_bytes_used != tracked.bytes_used
          else
            ::Storage::TrackedRecord.cleanup_now(record_type: "Comment", record_id: tracked.record_id, account_id: id)
          end
        end
      end
    end
end

class Storage::SyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :backend

  retry_on ActiveRecord::Deadlocked, ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
  discard_on ActiveJob::DeserializationError

  def initialize(record = nil)
    super
    @account = record.account if record.respond_to?(:account)
  end

  def perform(record)
    record.sync_storage_now
  end
end
EOF

class Storage::CleanupJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :backend

  retry_on ActiveRecord::Deadlocked, ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique

  def initialize(*args)
    super
    @account = nil
  end

  def perform(record_type, record_id, account_id)
    Storage::TrackedRecord.cleanup_now(record_type: record_type, record_id: record_id, account_id: account_id)
  end
end

**Reflecting on Active Storage and Concern Inclusion**

Okay, so I'm reviewing the structure here, and I'm pleased to see how cleanly the concern lists are alphabetized across various models: `Account`, `Board`, `Card`, `Comment`—and yes, `Storage` fits right in with that alphabetical order!

Now, let's zero in on `ActiveStorage::Attachment` and specifically what's happening in `config/initializers/active_storage.rb`. I'm reminding myself that `ActiveStorage::Attachment` has `purge` and `purge_later` defined directly on the class. A critical point here: if we include a concern on `ActiveStorage::Attachment`, methods defined in that included module would sit *below* `ActiveStorage::Attachment` in the ancestor chain. That means a simple `def purge` in an `included` module *wouldn't* override `ActiveStorage::Attachment#purge`! Got to be careful there.

That's when I had the "AHA!" moment. In Ruby, it all boils down to how we handle inheritance:
- `include` places the module *after* the class in the `.ancestors` chain, which means class methods like `ActiveStorage::Attachment#purge` would effectively shadow module methods.
- `prepend` is the key. It places the module *before* the class in the `.ancestors` chain. This ensures that any `super` calls in the module will correctly reference `ActiveStorage::Attachment#purge`.
- This same logic applies to `ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachOne#detach` and `DetachMany#detach`—we *must* use `prepend` there too.

Next, I need to double-check `ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageTracking`.
- `ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment)` runs once when `ActiveStorage::Attachment` loads which is helpful.
- Using `Rails.application.config.to_prepare` (or `on_load(:active_storage_attachment)` for `after_create_commit` / `after_destroy` / `after_destroy_commit` plus `prepend` for `purge`/`purge_later`) keeps those callbacks from being registered multiple times across reloads, and `prepend` wraps `purge`/`purge_later` cleanly!
- I can make this even more robust: checking `unless ActiveStorage::Attachment < ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageTracking` is a good practice (or putting that check inside `ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment)` which runs once per class load). And for `DetachOne` / `DetachMany`, definitely put `prepend` inside `ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment)` or `unless ... < ...` in `to_prepare`!

The last thing to check: does `ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachOne` get loaded eagerly when `ActiveStorage::Attachment` loads, or lazily? I need to make sure that a call like `unless DetachOne < ...; DetachOne.prepend(...); end` in `Rails.application.config.to_prepare` will ensure that the prepending happens exactly once, avoiding any duplicate prepends.

module ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageCallbacks
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    after_create_commit :sync_storage_later
    after_destroy :capture_storage_target
    after_destroy_commit :sync_captured_storage_target_later
  end

  def storage_target
    if record_type == "Card" && name == "image"
      record
    elsif record_type == "ActionText::RichText" && name == "embeds"
      rich_text = record
      if rich_text && tracked_rich_text?(rich_text)
        rich_text.record
      end
    end
  end

  def storage_target_unless_suppressed
    target = storage_target
    target if target && !Storage.suppressed_for?(target)
  end

  private
    def tracked_rich_text?(rich_text)
      (rich_text.record_type == "Board" && rich_text.name == "public_description") ||
        (rich_text.record_type == "Card" && rich_text.name == "description") ||
        (rich_text.record_type == "Comment" && rich_text.name == "body")
    end

    def sync_storage_later
      Storage.sync_later(storage_target)
    end

    def capture_storage_target
      @captured_storage_target = storage_target_unless_suppressed
    end

    def sync_captured_storage_target_later
      if @captured_storage_target
        Storage.sync_later(@captured_storage_target)
        @captured_storage_target = nil
      end
    end
end

module ActiveStorageAttachmentStoragePurgeTracking
  def purge
    target = storage_target_unless_suppressed
    super
    Storage.sync_later(target) if target
  end

  def purge_later
    target = storage_target_unless_suppressed
    super
    Storage.sync_later(target) if target
  end
end

module ActiveStorageDetachOneStorageTracking
  def detach
    if attachment.present?
      target = attachment.storage_target_unless_suppressed
      super
      Storage.sync_later(target) if target
    else
      super
    end
  end
end

module ActiveStorageDetachManyStorageTracking
  def detach
    if attachments.any?
      targets = attachments.filter_map(&:storage_target_unless_suppressed).uniq
      super
      targets.each { |target| Storage.sync_later(target) }
    else
      super
    end
  end
end

ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment) do
  include ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageCallbacks
  prepend ActiveStorageAttachmentStoragePurgeTracking
end

Rails.application.config.to_prepare do
  unless ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachOne < ActiveStorageDetachOneStorageTracking
    ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachOne.prepend(ActiveStorageDetachOneStorageTracking)
  end

  unless ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachMany < ActiveStorageDetachManyStorageTracking
    ActiveStorage::Attached::Changes::DetachMany.prepend(ActiveStorageDetachManyStorageTracking)
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class Storage::EntryTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @account = accounts("37s")
    @board = boards(:writebook)
  end

  test "consolidate_now collapses multiple entries into one row" do
    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: 100)
    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: 250)
    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: -50)

    assert_equal 3, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @board).count
    assert_equal 3, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @account).count

    Storage::Entry.consolidate_now(@board)
    Storage::Entry.consolidate_now(@account)

    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @board).count
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @account).count
    assert_equal 300, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 300, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "consolidate_now removes all rows when total delta is zero" do
    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: 500)
    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: -500)

    Storage::Entry.consolidate_now(@board)
    Storage::Entry.consolidate_now(@account)

    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @board).count
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @account).count
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end

  test "exceeding consolidation threshold enqueues ConsolidateJob in the background" do
    (Storage::Entry::CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD - 1).times do
      Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: 10)
    end

    assert_no_enqueued_jobs only: Storage::ConsolidateJob do
      Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id)
    end

    Storage::Entry.record(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id, delta: 10)

    assert_enqueued_jobs 2, only: Storage::ConsolidateJob do
      Storage::Entry.consolidate_later_if_needed(account_id: @account.id, board_id: @board.id)
    end

    perform_enqueued_jobs only: Storage::ConsolidateJob

    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @board).count
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(owner: @account).count
    assert_equal Storage::Entry::CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD * 10, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal Storage::Entry::CONSOLIDATION_THRESHOLD * 10, @account.bytes_used
  end

**Debugging Deep Dive: A Test-Driven Revelation**

Okay, wow, these test failures are screaming for attention! Thank goodness for early testing; it's practically a gold mine of information! Let's dissect *every* single one of these errors.

### Issue 1: A Real Bug!

Looking at the `StorageTest`, specifically `test_rapid_consecutive_card_moves_settle_on_accurate_board_totals` and `test_moving_a_card_off_a_board_right_before_destroying_the_board_preserves_the_moved_card_usage_on_account`, we have `Expected: 0, Actual: 12794` and `Expected: 12794, Actual: 0` respectively. That's a huge discrepancy.

My initial thought is the code at `app/models/card.rb` line 48 in the `move_to` method might be the root cause and also `Card::Storage`.

Now, why did the first test, fail with `Expected: 0, Actual: 12794` on `@other_board`? Let's trace it.

1.  A `card` was on `@board`, and the `Storage::TrackedRecord` had `@board.id`.
2.  `card.move_to(@other_board)` committed, enqueuing a `SyncJob(card)`.
3.  `card.move_to(third_board)` committed, enqueuing another `SyncJob(card)`.
4.  `perform_enqueued_jobs` ran.
    I see now, in `test_rapid_consecutive_card_moves` line 217, it's asserting `@other_board.bytes_used` equals 0. But why is it actually `12794`?

The root of the issue is that both `SyncJob(card)`s were running. The first job moved the storage from `@board` to `third_board`, but the intermediate check was still looking at `@other_board`. But, Why did `@other_board` have `12794`? Time to inspect the relevant code, `test/models/storage_test.rb` from lines 200-220, and `test_helper.rb`.

AHA! In `test_helper.rb` line 58, `Current.account = nil`! The `perform_enqueued_jobs` method is setting `Current.account` to `nil`. This is the crucial missing piece. I now understand the interaction of `ActiveStorageAttachmentStorageCallbacks`, `ActiveStorage::Attachment`, `ActionText::RichText`, and `Storage::TrackedRecord`.

The error, `ActiveRecord::RecordNotSaved: Failed to save the new associated image_attachment` is because the `blob.attach` is failing inside `perform_enqueued_jobs` because of that `Current.account = nil`.

Looking closer at `config/initializers/uuid_framework_models.rb`, `ActiveStorage::Attachment.belongs_to :account, default: -> { record.account }`. and `config/initializers/active_storage.rb`, `ActiveStorage::Attachment#after_destroy :capture_storage_target` . The fix is, because `perform_enqueued_jobs`sets `Current.account = nil`. This is when the issue occurs.
The solution to the issue is:

1.  Create records outside the `perform_enqueued_jobs` block
2.  Run `perform_enqueued_jobs` *after* the record creation.

Looking at other tests, it's either:
`card = ...create!...`
`perform_enqueued_jobs` (no block!)

OR
`perform_enqueued_jobs do` only when `Current.account` isn't needed!

Now, the remaining puzzle: Why did `test_rapid_consecutive_card_moves_settle_on_accurate_board_totals` fail at line 217 (`Expected: 0, Actual: 12794`), and why did `test_moving_a_card_off_a_board_right_before_destroying_the_board` fail at line 312 (`Expected: 12794, Actual: 0`)? We need to inspect `test/models/storage_test.rb` lines 195-320 and trace both of these test scenarios precisely.

messages.thinking:
**Decoding the ActiveStorage Puzzle**

Aha! This is interesting. I've noticed a pattern. Both in `test_rapid_consecutive_card_moves` and `test_moving_a_card_off_a_board_right_before_destroying_the_board`, specifically lines 207 and 303, the creation of the card, `card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Movable", status: :published, image: blob)`, was wrapped inside `perform_enqueued_jobs do ... end`. *   Use `after_update :mark_board_change_for_storage, if: :saved_change_to_board_id?` (sets `@board_changed_for_storage = true`)
*   Use `after_update_commit :sync_storage_later, if: -> { @board_changed_for_storage }` (and clears `@board_changed_for_storage = false`).

  end

      ActiveStorage::Attachment

    def sync_board_change_storage_later
      if @board_changed_for_storage

      ::Storage.suppressing_destroy(self, &block)

      if @enqueue_storage_cleanup
        @enqueue_storage_cleanup = false
        ::Storage::CleanupJob.perform_later("Card", id, account_id)
      end
    end
end

    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used

    assert_equal blob3.byte_size, @board.bytes_used

class StorageUsageTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do

      io: file_fixture("avatar.png").open,
      filename: "avatar.png",
      content_type: "image/png"
    )

    # Create a card with an image and description embed via controller
    post board_cards_path(@board), params: {
      card: {
        title: "Storage card",
        image: fixture_file_upload("moon.jpg", "image/jpeg"),
        description: embed_html
      }
    }, as: :json
    assert_response :created
    card = @board.cards.find_by!(title: "Storage card")

    # Add a comment with an embedded file via controller
    comment_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: file_fixture("avatar.svg").open,
      filename: "avatar.svg",
      content_type: "image/svg+xml"
    )
    post card_comments_path(card), params: {
      comment: { body: ActionText::Content.new("").append_attachables([ comment_blob ]).to_html }
    }, as: :json
    assert_response :created

    perform_enqueued_jobs

    expected = image_size + embed_blob.byte_size + comment_blob.byte_size
    assert_equal expected, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal expected, @account.bytes_used

    # Purge card image via Cards::ImagesController

    assert_response :no_content
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    expected -= image_size
    assert_equal expected, @board.bytes_used
    assert_equal expected, @account.bytes_used

    assert_equal expected, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal expected, @account.bytes_used

    delete card_path(card), as: :json
    assert_response :no_content
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @other_board.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
  end
end
